title: Ssangyong Engineering & Construction Co. Ltd. v. National Highways Authority of India

content.caseIdentity: Ssangyong Engineering & Construction Co. Ltd. v. National Highways Authority of India, (2019) 15 SCC 131
content.facts: The Court considered a Section 34 challenge after the 2015 amendments.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the permissible scope of judicial intervention after the amended Section 34 regime?
content.ratioDecidendi: The amended Section 34 limits judicial intervention and the court cannot effectively reassess the merits of the award.
content.holding: The Court applied the post-amendment narrow review framework.
content.relevance: Key post-2015 authority on Section 34, subject to later Supreme Court clarification.
